name: Grip | Lemon Cherry Sherbet
description: Lemon Cherry Sherbet is a slightly indica-leaning hybrid made from Lemon Cherry Gelato x Sunset Sherbet. It offers a sweet citrus-cherry flavor and balanced effects that uplift the mind while relaxing the body. Ideal for stress, anxiety, fatigue, depression, and headaches, it brings a happy, social buzz without weighing you down.
